name: Box sorter
summary: A friend's move-out as a conveyor belt of their drawn stuff: drag the thing at the front into Keep, Sell or Give, friends help sort, and everything in Sell becomes a drafted Marketplace listing with a price; things the owner will never sell make the box shake.
useWhen: 'i move out in 2 weeks and i have SO much stuff'
help me figure out what to sell vs keep before moving
friends helping someone declutter before a move-out
turning a pile of move-out stuff into marketplace listings
arun what are you doing with all your stuff lol
dontUseWhen: a shared apartment's jointly owned things after a lease ends (use lease-divvy)
free stuff left on the curb for anyone to grab (use curb-alert)

when.description: Short timing line, e.g. 'moves out in 14 days'

items.description: 3 to 14 things in belt order: name, kind (lamp, fridge, hangers, cooker, chair, books, plant, mirror, fan, box), suggested price in cents, noSell for things the owner will never sell

sorted.description: Things already sorted, from the front of the belt: item index, box (keep, sell, give), who, and a short line they said
